paragraphs: [Glosses: Rami. (1) Ta'anit 9a: Rami bar Hama said that Rav said, ‘What is “until there is no sufficiency”?’ In Shabbat 32b the gloss reads Rami bar Rav in Rav’s name, ‘What is “until,”’ etc. The checked Shabbat text records both Rav and Hama.; in Makkot 23b: Rami bar Rav, ‘What is “until,”’ etc. Not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally “not corrected”, here and below]. (2) Zevahim 62b: Rami bar Hizkiyah should read Yehezkel; ל״ח [formula unresolved]. (3) Hullin 110a: Rami bar Tamrei, namely Rami bar Dekulei. Menahot 29, beginning of b: Ra'ami bar Tamrei, father-in-law of Rami bar Dekulei. Yevamot 80a: Rami bar Dekulei. Which is right needs examination; not corrected.] Rami bar Yehezkel. Shabbat 60a. Rami bar Yehezkel taught: Eruvin 14b, 58b; Shabbat 138a. ‘Rami bar Yehizkiyah taught,’ Zevahim 62b, should read Yehezkel, since that very matter in Yoma 58b has Yehezkel. Rav Yehudah was his brother: Ketubbot 21, end of a, 60a. He said, ‘Do not heed these rules my brother Yehudah formulated in Shmuel's name’; see there, 76b. Hullin 44a: when Rami bar Yehezkel came he said, ‘Do not heed these rules my brother Yehudah formulated in Rav's name.’ Rav Yehezkel taught his son Rami. Rav Yehudah said, ‘Father, do not teach it this way’ (Kiddushin 32a). He sent to Rav Huna, ‘Tell us the excellent things you told us in Rav's name’: Shabbat 138b. He sent to Rav Amram, ‘Tell us some of Rav Assi's statements’: Eruvin 102a. Yerushalmi Ta’anit, at the end of chapter 2, has R' Ba in the name of R' Immi bar Yehezkel in Rav’s name, and R' Ze'ira in Rav Yehudah’s name. Yerushalmi Eruvin, Keitzad Me’abberin, also gives R' Ba, Ammi bar Yehezkel, and Rav. He came to Benei Berak and saw goats eating figs, with honey flowing from the figs and milk from them. He said, ‘This is the Land of Israel's flowing with milk and honey’: Ketubbot 111b.
